why:
Measured against the recorded upstream surfaces (`docs/reference/api-surface/{rclc,rclcpp,rclrs}.json`): none of them contains `park`, `wake_source`, `spin_nominal` or `granularity` at all, so there is no upstream name to align to. Same basis as the `Executor::release_jitter` pair beside it.

phase-436. A port registers `k_poll`, `epoll`, a queue set or a device ISR here and the executor only ever asks "when will you next need me?" — the core never names an RTOS. Refuses past capacity rather than dropping silently: a source quietly discarded would leave the executor sleeping past a deadline it had been told about, which is the failure this phase exists to remove.
